name: Keeping Order
overview: Scripture teaches that keeping order is a God-ordained principle essential for both the church and society. Believers are called to submit to governing authorities because all power is established by God (Romans 13:1), and within the church, orderly conduct and steadfast faith are marks of spiritual health (Colossians 2:5). This order extends to leadership structures, as elders are to be appointed to maintain what is lacking (Titus 1:5), and believers are instructed to obey and submit to their leaders who watch over their souls with accountability (Hebrews 13:17). Furthermore, maintaining order involves humility and valuing others above oneself, avoiding strife and selfish ambition (Philippians 2:3).
